example_sentences_in_bangla: চুরির ঘটনায় লালপাগড়ির সাহায্য নেওয়া হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone runs away at the sight of the red-turbaned cops.
The police will be called in for the theft incident.
history: Refers to British colonial-era police officers in Bengal who wore red turbans as part of their uniform, symbolizing authority and law enforcement.
note: This idiom originates from the visual identifier of police headgear during the colonial period.
